Would you like to spend your free time doing more work in school than you usually do?. I think a lot of kids would be against the idea of having to stay after school for homework club. If you do to much work you might overwork yourself and that wouldn't be good for your health. There are many examples, that show overworking could make you stressed or get headache. That is why I desagree that they should start an afterschool homework club.

One of the many reasons, is you need free time after a long day of school. A lot of kids can get frustated and angry if, they didn't get much free time. An example, would be sleeping in class because, a lot of students

like to take naps afterschool but, they wouldn't be able to if they had to stay afterschool. Another example, is that they wouldn't want to come to school and that may be because, of to much work. There would also be to much hours of having to stay in school like, doing

exams, test, quizzes, or class work.

there are also many students that have partime jobs. Having afterschool homework club would cause problems if they have to work. Not all students get free time like others, maybe they want to earn money but, they wouldn't be able to if they add a afterschool club. An example, would be if you work around 3:00pm, you wouldn't be able to work because, clubs can be an hour and a half long and usually middle schools end at around 2:30. That is why having afterschools clubs could affect some students.

my final reason, is teachers and students feel tired after a hole day of school. In my opinion they shouldn't add more hours to school, that way they have more time to rest and not worried about school work. Teachers can

get stressed because, of students behaviors. An example, would be students not listening to the teacher, that might make the teachers want to go home early. Even students can get stressed by teachers, it can be because, teachers yell to much and students can get headache for that. That's why students and also teachers would like to have more time to rest.

In conclution, they shouldn't add an afterschool homework club because, all students and teachers have other stuff to do that don't envolve school. Having to many hours of school can cause them to have stress and headache for having to do a lot of homework. Also a lot of students have partime jobs so, they wouln't stay after school. Finally, they have other activities to do and they wouldn't make them, if they have to go to the clubs. Remember students deserve their free time and teachers too, so do you agree with me?.

Dear Principle,

If our school were to change the cafeteria food to healthier food selections it would be a bad idea. This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing.

Based on Emerson's statement, I firmly agree that if you never try to do something beyond what you already know, you will never do something and know if you could have done it or of you were good at it. Based on my experience, for what I've live and for what I know, I strongly believe and agree with this statement. My brother for example wanted to be an engineer, with hard work and effort he made it. In the other hand we have Hitler, he went from being a simple art student to one of the most exponent dictators of Germany.

For example, my brother wanted to be an engineer since he was little, at the time he reach High school, he was sure what career he wanted for his future. He started taking courses that would help him get credits for college and getting involve with sports that would help him get scholarships. Also, he took classes that would help him improve his skills and understanding of his future career. Now with hard work and effort, he graduated as an engineer from Generic_school and he's happily working with his dream job. This shows that with hard work you can accomplish any goal and letting yourself grow.

Another example was Hitler, he went from being a simple art student to one of the most exponent dictators of Germany. At a young age Hitler had a dream, he wanted to study arts, he started working on it, but when he apply to college he wasn't accepted. That was the moment when Hitler decided to do something different, and experience something new that could change his life. With hard work and patience he did it. Even though he fail the first time, he didn't give up, therefore, he became a dictator.

You need to let yourself expand and fly to grow and experience something beyond what you already know, something that will make proud at the end of the day.

In conclusion I agree with Emerson's statement that if you never try yo do something beyond what you already know, you will never grow and never have experience something out of your comfort zone. You'll

never know if what you could have done was worth your time, which is why you should always try to something beyond what you have already master and challenge yourself to do bigger things that you never knew you could.

history.text:
In many student's life, there is a set goal of succeeding in school in order to open doors in the future. Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. However, companies do not just pick any person;

they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. I am one of a kind.

"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U009","start":1050,"end":1137,"text":"This shows that with hard work you can accomplish any goal and letting yourself grow.
"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U010","start":1137,"end":1257,"text":"
Another example was Hitler, he went from being a simple art student to one of the most exponent dictators of Germany. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U011","start":1257,"end":1392,"text":"At a young age Hitler had a dream, he wanted to study arts, he started working on it, but when he apply to college he wasn't accepted. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U012","start":1392,"end":1516,"text":"That was the moment when Hitler decided to do something different, and experience something new that could change his life. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U013","start":1516,"end":1555,"text":"With hard work and patience he did it. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U014","start":1555,"end":1644,"text":"Even though he fail the first time, he didn't give up, therefore, he became a dictator.
"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U015","start":1644,"end":1998,"text":"
Some people say that you should do what life gives you at the moment because even if you work hard, sometimes you don't reach what you were hoping for and the work is not even worth it, however, you should always try to do something to grow because if you don't, that's when life gets too bored, you don't have to be in the same spot your entire life. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U016","start":1998,"end":2156,"text":"You need to let yourself expand and fly to grow and experience something beyond what you already know, something that will make proud at the end of the day.
"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U017","start":2156,"end":2355,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U019","start":2365,"end":2583,"text":"never know if what you could have done was worth your time, which is why you should always try to something beyond what you have already master and challenge yourself to do bigger things that you never knew you could. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U002","start":106,"end":258,"text":"Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U003","start":258,"end":403,"text":"Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U004","start":403,"end":496,"text":"Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U005","start":496,"end":547,"text":"However, companies do not just pick any person;

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U006","start":547,"end":664,"text":"they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U007","start":664,"end":786,"text":"To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U008","start":786,"end":914,"text":"It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U009","start":914,"end":962,"text":"
I am not a stranger to the engineering field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U010","start":962,"end":1020,"text":"I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U025","start":2457,"end":2593,"text":"
Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U027","start":2728,"end":2824,"text":"I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U028","start":2824,"end":2935,"text":"Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U029","start":2935,"end":2981,"text":"For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U030","start":2981,"end":3071,"text":"I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U031","start":3071,"end":3180,"text":"However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U032","start":3180,"end":3269,"text":"Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U034","start":3343,"end":3428,"text":"Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U035","start":3428,"end":3470,"text":"
The path to success in not an easy one. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U036","start":3470,"end":3519,"text":"One must submit to hours of work and dedication. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U037","start":3519,"end":3600,"text":"In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U038","start":3600,"end":3703,"text":"Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U039","start":3703,"end":3784,"text":"Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U040","start":3784,"end":3849,"text":"My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U041","start":3849,"end":3970,"text":"My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U042","start":3970,"end":4091,"text":"One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U043","start":4091,"end":4166,"text":"For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U044","start":4166,"end":4299,"text":"The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U045","start":4299,"end":4426,"text":"Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U046","start":4426,"end":4528,"text":"I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U047","start":4528,"end":4631,"text":"I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U048","start":4631,"end":4650,"text":"I am one of a kind."}],"traits":{"Cohesion":4,"Syntax":5,"Vocabulary":5,"Phraseology":4,"Grammar":4,"Conventions":5}}],"official_rubric":{"5":{"Overall":"Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U012","start":1392,"end":1516,"text":"That was the moment when Hitler decided to do something different, and experience something new that could change his life. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U013","start":1516,"end":1555,"text":"With hard work and patience he did it. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U014","start":1555,"end":1644,"text":"Even though he fail the first time, he didn't give up, therefore, he became a dictator.
"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U015","start":1644,"end":1998,"text":"
Some people say that you should do what life gives you at the moment because even if you work hard, sometimes you don't reach what you were hoping for and the work is not even worth it, however, you should always try to do something to grow because if you don't, that's when life gets too bored, you don't have to be in the same spot your entire life. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U016","start":1998,"end":2156,"text":"You need to let yourself expand and fly to grow and experience something beyond what you already know, something that will make proud at the end of the day.
"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U017","start":2156,"end":2355,"text":"
In conclusion I agree with Emerson's statement that if you never try yo do something beyond what you already know, you will never grow and never have experience something out of your comfort zone. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U018","start":2355,"end":2365,"text":"You'll

"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U019","start":2365,"end":2583,"text":"never know if what you could have done was worth your time, which is why you should always try to something beyond what you have already master and challenge yourself to do bigger things that you never knew you could. "},{"span_id":"1440:1@U008","start":791,"end":955,"text":"It is not only bad for students it is bad for teachers too they have to stay in school for a long time too or a longer time than us because they have to clean up.

"},{"span_id":"1440:1@U017","start":1747,"end":1789,"text":"Please dont change the time of the school."}]},{"essay_id":"8745:1","overall":5,"spans":[{"span_id":"8745:1@U001","start":0,"end":106,"text":"In many student's life, there is a set goal of succeeding in school in order to open doors in the future. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U002","start":106,"end":258,"text":"Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U003","start":258,"end":403,"text":"Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U004","start":403,"end":496,"text":"Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U005","start":496,"end":547,"text":"However, companies do not just pick any person;

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U006","start":547,"end":664,"text":"they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U007","start":664,"end":786,"text":"To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U008","start":786,"end":914,"text":"It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U009","start":914,"end":962,"text":"
I am not a stranger to the engineering field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U010","start":962,"end":1020,"text":"I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U025","start":2457,"end":2593,"text":"
Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U027","start":2728,"end":2824,"text":"I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U028","start":2824,"end":2935,"text":"Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U029","start":2935,"end":2981,"text":"For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U030","start":2981,"end":3071,"text":"I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U031","start":3071,"end":3180,"text":"However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U032","start":3180,"end":3269,"text":"Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U034","start":3343,"end":3428,"text":"Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U035","start":3428,"end":3470,"text":"
The path to success in not an easy one. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U036","start":3470,"end":3519,"text":"One must submit to hours of work and dedication. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U037","start":3519,"end":3600,"text":"In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U038","start":3600,"end":3703,"text":"Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U039","start":3703,"end":3784,"text":"Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U040","start":3784,"end":3849,"text":"My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U041","start":3849,"end":3970,"text":"My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U042","start":3970,"end":4091,"text":"One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U043","start":4091,"end":4166,"text":"For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U044","start":4166,"end":4299,"text":"The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U045","start":4299,"end":4426,"text":"Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U046","start":4426,"end":4528,"text":"I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U047","start":4528,"end":4631,"text":"I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U048","start":4631,"end":4650,"text":"I am one of a kind."}]}],"official_rubric":{"5":{"Overall":"Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. However, companies do not just pick any person;

they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. I am not a stranger to the engineering field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U010","start":962,"end":1020,"text":"I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. 公式条件一覧のどの段階・観点からも関連条件を選択できます。観測Overallや一方向の隣接段階に固定しません。Overallを主とし、分析的観点を使う場合は補助という位置づけを明記します。条件ID・原文の転記はプログラムが行います。程度・頻度・適切さ・伝達阻害の限定を保った条件を選んでください。
次の5つを分けて説明します。(1)本文で確認できる具体的特徴、(2)理由の評価判断、(3)条件に照らし支持できる評価の仕方、(4)一致・見直す余地・判断不能、(5)そこから導かれる一つの確認行動。
全文を今読んでいるので、システムで確認できることを先に確認してください。局所誤りから全体頻度・強い理解阻害を断定しません。組織と文法を混同しません。読める不正確さと、主語・指示対象・命題を補わないと読めない箇所を区別し、実際のspanを調べてください。
⑤は「全文確認」「頻度確認」だけでは不十分です。何と何を区別するか、どのspanや段落を見るか、何を確かめるかを一つの論点から一つの行動にします。新しい件数閾値・減点・得点上限を作りません。本文引用を自由生成せずspan_idで指定してください。
日本語のJSONのみ。relationships配列の各要素の必須キー:
issue_id（I1等）、claim_ids（入力のeligible主張）、span_ids（対象本文の有効ID）、condition_ids（関連する公式条件ID）、feature_confirmed、inferred_judgment、rubric_based_proposal、agreement_review_unknown、system_checked（span_idsとfindingを持つ配列）、next_action（distinguish、where_span_ids、action、reasonを持つオブジェクト）、scope_limit。日本語説明は具体的な内容にし、この仕様説明を復唱しないでください。
最上位はrelationshipsを持つオブジェクトです。system_checkedのキーはspan_ids（配列）でありspan_idではありません。OUTPUT_JSON_SCHEMAを厳守します。
feature_confirmedとfindingでは、単に「一般的な構造」「誤用が観察される」と書かず、どの語形・主語と動詞の関係・節の接続・指示対象・主張と具体例の関係を確認したかを示します。対象全文で複雑な節や適切な接続が見つかるなら、単純な文だけの答案という理由をそのまま支持しません。
rubric_based_proposalは基準を満たすと宣言するだけでは不十分です。確認した特徴が条件のどの程度・頻度・伝達への影響に関わるかを説明します。Overallを主な照合先とし、分析的観点だけでOverallの段階や重みを確定しません。
next_action.actionには見分ける具体的な関係を明記します。誤用が意味理解に影響するか確認、と繰り返すだけでは不足です。主語・動詞・指示先・命題のどれを補う必要があるかなど、今確認できた箇所に基づく一つの行動にします。説明欄は各120字程度を目安に簡潔にしてください。
analysis_anchors配列を1～2件返します。各要素はspan_id、tokens（そのspan原文の異なる語を2語以上、修正せず完全一致で選ぶ）、relation（その語同士の具体的な文法・指示・論理関係）、interpretation（実際に何が読み取れ、何が補足を要するか）です。引用と語の文字位置はプログラムで取得します。単に誤用が観察される、と書かず、選んだ語の形や前後関係を説明してください。
